chain.title: Pity Machine Frame
chain.desc: Craft the first machine frame from four logs, four iron ingots and a redstone block; every early IF machine is built around it.

chain.title: Tree Fluid Extractor
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, a piston, iron and a light weighted pressure plate; place it facing a log to slowly extract latex fluid.

chain.title: Pitiful Generator
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, a furnace, gold and iron bars; it burns solid fuel into a small amount of FE to run your first machines.

chain.title: Latex Processing Unit
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, furnace, buckets and a redstone block; it consumes latex, water and FE to produce tiny dry rubber.

chain.title: Tiny Dry Rubber
chain.desc: Collect tiny dry rubber from the Latex Processing Unit as it processes latex and water.

chain.title: Dry Rubber
chain.desc: Combine nine tiny dry rubber in a crafting grid into one dry rubber ball.

chain.title: Plastic
chain.desc: Smelt dry rubber in a furnace to get plastic, the ingredient gating nearly every IF machine.

chain.title: Plant Sower
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, plastic, a flower pot, iron gears and a piston; it auto-plants crops and saplings in the area above it.

chain.title: Plant Gatherer
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, plastic, an iron axe and hoe and a gold gear; it harvests grown crops and trees into its inventory.

chain.title: Mob Slaughter Factory
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, plastic, iron swords and axes; it kills mobs dropping no loot but producing liquid meat and pink slime fluid.

chain.title: Dissolution Chamber
chain.desc: Craft with a pity frame, plastic, gold, a diamond gear, buckets and a chest; it combines eight items with a fluid and is required for all higher frames.

chain.title: Simple Machine Frame
chain.desc: Make in the Dissolution Chamber: a pity frame, plastic, nether bricks, iron and a gold gear with 250 mB of latex.

chain.title: Advanced Machine Frame
chain.desc: Make in the Dissolution Chamber: a simple frame, plastic, netherite scrap, gold and a diamond gear with 500 mB of pink slime.

chain.title: Mob Crusher
chain.desc: Craft with an advanced frame, plastic, gold gears and a book; it kills mobs with Looting, yielding drops, XP and mob essence.

chain.title: Laser Drill
chain.desc: Craft with a simple frame, plastic, pistons and a diamond gear; aim drills at a laser base to generate ores from nothing.

chain.title: Ore Laser Base
chain.desc: Craft with an advanced frame, plastic, iron ore, a diamond pickaxe and a diamond gear; colored lenses in it bias which ores the lasers produce.

chain.title: Stasis Chamber
chain.desc: Craft with an advanced frame, pistons, soul sand and a ghast tear; it freezes mobs, and is the standard way to hold a Wither safely.

chain.title: Fluid Laser Base
chain.desc: Craft with an advanced frame, plastic, a bucket and a diamond gear; laser drills pointed at it while a Wither is trapped nearby collect ether gas.

chain.title: Supreme Machine Frame
chain.desc: Make in the Dissolution Chamber: an advanced frame, plastic, netherite ingots, diamonds and a diamond gear with 135 mB of ether gas.

chain.title: Wither Builder
chain.desc: Craft with a supreme frame, plastic, wither skeleton skulls, soul sand and a nether star; it auto-assembles Withers for farming.

chain.title: Mycelial Reactor
chain.desc: Make in the Dissolution Chamber from a supreme frame, netherite, diamond gears and a nether star with ether gas; it outputs massive FE when all 16 mycelial generators run beside it.

chain.title: Infinity Drill
chain.desc: Make in the Dissolution Chamber from diamond blocks, a diamond shovel, a tier-11 range addon and gold gears with pink slime; the FE-powered drill mines huge areas.

notes: Frame gating verified from recipes: pity=crafting table, simple/advanced/supreme=dissolution chamber with latex/pink slime/ether gas respectively. Ether gas comes from laser drills targeting a Wither (data/industrialforegoing/recipes/laser_drill_fluid/ether_gas.json), normally held in a stasis chamber. Note the Tree Fluid Extractor registry id is fluid_extractor. All ids set-checked against 122 item models in jar.
